calibration_review.scope: MVC shoulder trials before, after and one hour after repetitive work in three conditions. Article best-of-three versus table matching mean-of-three requires clarification; no measured force-displacement work.

name: Slade et al. between-day MVIC reliability study

calibration_review.access: Open CC BY 4.0 article, published aggregate summaries reviewed; individual supplementary data not used.
calibration_review.scope: 18 adults across 4 visits, isometric knee, elbow and grip methods; knee between-day MD95 25.9–33.7% of grand mean; not a direct leg press or individual baseline error estimate.

external_provenance.aggregate_provenance: article between-day reliability results; no raw data extraction

name: do Nascimento Salvador et al. cycling torque at two intensities

calibration_review.access: Article and Table 3 accessible; author data availability statement: individual data on reasonable request.
calibration_review.scope: 16-person repeated torque means at HVY and VHI with 3-s maximal isokinetic probes, 12-min bouts; no individual measurements or actual work in this extraction.

external_provenance.availability: individual data available from corresponding author on reasonable request

name: Chang et al. repeated sprint recovery dataset passive control

calibration_review.access: Mendeley v1 CC BY 4.0, XLSX downloaded; publisher SHA256 verified.
calibration_review.scope: 12 recreationally trained men, passive control after fatigue and 20-minute rest, five 10-s cycling sprints. Mean power unit W inferred from protocol and magnitude, not labeled in sheet; first 3 control columns previewed before analysis protocol.

name: Souron et al. cognitive condition cycling time-to-failure data v1

calibration_review.access: Zenodo v1 CC BY 4.0; publisher MD5 and file byte SHA256 verified. Article and seven data rows previewed before analysis.
calibration_review.scope: 18 participants, within-person conditions and 80% PPO cycling time to voluntary or cadence-defined failure; workbook PPO and durations, continuous power and full CPE45 profile not verified.

name: de Poli et al. cycling work and knee-extension force before and after training

calibration_review.access: Full article and rounded group table viewed; individual data reported available on reasonable request, actual availability and reuse terms unverified.
calibration_review.scope: 21 active males, two groups and pre/post five-week sessions; constant relative CWR intensity, exercise time, total work and knee-extension iMVC before and post. Absolute work not matched, measurements incomplete for CPE45.

name: Aguirre sit-to-stand kinematic fatigue data Figshare v2

calibration_review.access: v2 CC BY 4.0 ZIP downloaded; publisher MD5 and byte SHA-256 verified. Current v3 is metadata-only.
calibration_review.scope: 60 raw TXT paths, only 58 distinct SHA-256; processed CSV 660x34 with no exact duplicate rows or columns. Participant and processed-row mapping unresolved; no direct force or mechanical work.

name: Kudzia et al. leg force and force control with fatigue

calibration_review.access: Open article; linked Zenodo v1 ZIP downloaded and publisher MD5 verified, containing only README and license. GitHub main inspected at commit 330dbca093e462771545e230deba0f11f16d1486; individual records not obtained.
calibration_review.scope: 18 healthy participants, leg maximum force, force-control responsiveness and variability in constrained pre/fatigue tasks. No direct mechanical work or CPE45.

name: Hip strength test-retest in recreational cyclists

calibration_review.access: CC BY 4.0 public XLSX downloaded, publisher MD5 and byte SHA-256 verified; article and first three participant records previewed.
calibration_review.scope: 25 recreational cyclists, repeated unilateral isometric hip flexion/extension at two sessions with two devices. Not leg press or CPE45; device flexion positions differ.

name: Petré et al. HIIT and leg press and jump recovery

calibration_review.access: Open author manuscript, group table and methods reviewed; individual data location and reuse conditions not established.
calibration_review.scope: 15 elite female ice hockey players; cycling HIIT work measured, isometric leg press and countermovement jumps at rest, 10 min, 6 h and 24 h; individual actual work linkage not obtained.

name: Petré et al. isometric leg press and jump test-retest

calibration_review.access: Open publication; group statistics and figure 3 limits viewed, individual tabular data location not established.
calibration_review.scope: 13 elite female ice hockey players, 24-hour test-retest of best-of-three isometric leg press and jump; overlap with SRC-0106 unknown.

name: Natera et al. loaded repeated countermovement jump force and power

calibration_review.access: CC BY 4.0 11 XLSX downloaded; publisher MD5 and file SHA-256 stored in manifest. Article, author code and first record of one series previewed.
calibration_review.scope: 11 trained men performing 20 loaded countermovement jumps. Workbook net power is derived. Article states 2.5 Hz acceleration filtering while linked MATLAB uses a 0.25 Hz high-pass; actual pipeline unresolved.

name: Natera et al. repeated jump and physical fitness participant summaries

calibration_review.access: CC BY 4.0 de-identified CSV downloaded; publisher MD5 and byte SHA-256 checked. Article and CSV header viewed before analysis protocol.
calibration_review.scope: Ten trained male field hockey players with half squat, sprint and derived repeat-jump decrement; feature selection was reported on the same data and overlap with SRC-0108 unknown.

name: Natera et al. original bilateral force recordings for loaded jumps

calibration_review.access: CC BY 4.0; first CSV downloaded; publisher MD5 and byte SHA-256 verified; first timestamps and headers previewed.
calibration_review.scope: One bilateral force CSV exactly matched one processed force interval in SRC-0108. Stored power reproduced with author 0.25 Hz algorithm on this pair; sample timestamps indicate 500 Hz while article reports 1000 Hz acquisition.

name: Norbury et al. leg press load and post-exercise knee force

calibration_review.access: CC BY 4.0 XLSX downloaded; publisher MD5 and SHA-256 verified. Article and low-load individual rows previewed before protocol.
calibration_review.scope: 12 healthy men, randomized crossover. Only free-flow low/high-load leg press conditions analyzed; knee extension force at baseline and 5/45 min, 24 h after short exercise. Volume is load times repetitions (kg·reps), not mechanical work in Joules.

name: Kozinc et al. plantarflexion moment, position, speed and MVIC

calibration_review.access: Zenodo ZIP and XLSX downloaded; publisher MD5 and local SHA-256 verified.
calibration_review.scope: 21 participants in raw archive (S001..S021, 126 records) vs 20 in article (S021 extra/pilot); coordinate polarity between left and right leg resolved (spindle coordinate flips velocity sign on opposite leg in 3/6 sheets); physical discrepancy between angle and velocity integrals is median 1.05 J. Decisive LOSO test conducted in EXP-0135.

name: Precision grip force coordination after unilateral fatigue

calibration_review.access: Figshare ZIP and DOCX downloaded; ZIP publisher MD5 and local SHA-256 verified.
calibration_review.scope: 16 women; repeated 3D fingertip force traces in two fatigue-side sessions. 62 post-condition files have identical numerical payloads across participants and hands; source validity unresolved.

name: Arslan et al. lumbar isokinetic and Wingate peak power

calibration_review.access: CC BY 4.0 XLSX downloaded; MD5 and SHA-256 verified.
calibration_review.scope: 30 active young men; table averages match article; same-cohort exploratory LOPO only. Dynamic signals and post-exercise strength absent.

name: Evangelidis et al. hamstrings fatigue and maximal voluntary torque under isometric, concentric, and eccentric contractions

calibration_review.access: CC BY 4.0 XLSX and PDF downloaded from Springer ESM; SHA-256 verified against raw bytes.
calibration_review.scope: 9 healthy men; within-subject crossover (ISO, CON, ECC); 99 submaximal knee flexions at 50% MVT on Con-Trex isokinetic dynamometer (0-40 deg RoM at 8 deg/s). Pronounced fatigue (18-34% MVT drop). Dynamic mechanical work (~2.5-4.7 kJ) and active impulse measured across all sessions. Decisive LOSO test conducted in EXP-0136.
